mapper.sql: r.id, r.activity_id, r.user_id, r.score, r.content, r.anonymous, r.create_time, a.title as activity_title, u.real_name as user_name
mapper.select:
select
from activity_review r join activity a on a.id = r.activity_id left join sys_user u on u.id = r.user_id where r.activity_id = #{activityId} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc

select
from activity_review r join activity a on a.id = r.activity_id left join sys_user u on u.id = r.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
